entries.conditions: delegate error: 'ARG_MAX: Tensor type(INT64) is not supported.' torch argmax always yields int64, and a rank-0 result drags CAST/RESHAPE/SELECT/CONCATENATION into int64 with it (in-graph greedy sampling idiom).

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: ARG_MAX/CAST/CONCATENATION int64 refusals and GATHER_ND all gone; probe rewrite fully delegated, bit-exact vs stock chain
rewrite_hints.rewrite: reduce-max + arithmetic selector, int64-free: m = max(logits, keepdim); onehot = (logits >= m).float(); code = (onehot @ arange).int32; embedding row = onehot @ table (ties are measure-zero when noise is added pre-argmax)
rewrite_hints.symptom: in-graph argmax sampling (argmax -> cast -> index_select) strands an int64 op chain on CPU, x heads/steps in folded MTP graphs

entries.conditions: delegate error: 'BROADCAST_TO: Operation is not supported.' (flat, any rank observed). Emitted by torch expand / repeat_interleave — most commonly transformers' GQA repeat_kv (sdpa_attention.py) in models exported straight from HF modeling.

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: BROADCAST_TO disappears from the graph; LFM2.5-Encoder-230M went 136/828 partial -> full delegation (Metal and single-signature webgpu, 55x vs wasm)
rewrite_hints.rewrite: express the replication as an outer product with a ones row via matmul (or let the converter fold it to a broadcast MUL): x.reshape(b*h, s*d, 1) @ ones(1, n_rep) -> transpose -> reshape(b, h*n_rep, s, d); bitwise-identical to expand
rewrite_hints.symptom: expand/repeat_interleave lowers to BROADCAST_TO; delegate refuses it outright, stranding the attention block on CPU

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: int64 CAST removed from the graph (advisory guidance; no executable rule)
rewrite_hints.rewrite: avoid int64 in the exported graph: compute valid-lengths/positions in int32 or float32 before export, or host-side; interior CAST[int64] cannot be removed by io_cast and chain retype is outside the v1 rule vocabulary
rewrite_hints.symptom: int64 CAST in the exported graph (typically a valid-length or position computation)

entries.conditions: delegate error: 'GATHER_ND: Operation is not supported.' Two common producers measured: F.pad(mode='reflect') (mirror-index arithmetic + gather) and index_select/embedding-row lookup driven by an in-graph computed index.

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: GATHER_ND/STABLEHLO_PAD gone; 3-way construct probe: only the F.pad spelling refused, both rewrites delegated, outputs match at 6e-08
rewrite_hints.rewrite: spell reflect pad as slice + flip + concat (flip lowers to REVERSE_V2, accepted) or slice + constant reversal-matrix matmul + concat; both bitwise-identical to F.pad reflect
rewrite_hints.symptom: reflect padding lowers to GATHER_ND (and/or STABLEHLO_PAD); audio codec / vocoder graphs lose the pad+conv chain to CPU

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: GATHER_ND and the int64 index chain gone; construct probe bit-exact (max_abs 0) with the rewrite fully delegated
rewrite_hints.rewrite: one-hot matmul: onehot = (logits >= reduce_max(logits)) cast to float; row = onehot @ table; code = onehot @ arange as int32
rewrite_hints.symptom: table row lookup by a computed code (index_select after argmax) lowers to GATHER_ND

entries.conditions: delegate error: 'RESHAPE: Tensor dimensions must be less than 5.' Rank-5 intermediates typically come from the expand+reshape spelling of head replication (repeat_kv / repeat_interleave decomposition).

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: all rank-5 RESHAPE refusals gone; construct probe fully delegated with output match 9.5e-06
rewrite_hints.rewrite: keep every tensor rank<=4: fold the replication axis via the ones-matmul respelling (see BROADCAST_TO hint) instead of unsqueeze(2).expand(...).reshape(...)
rewrite_hints.symptom: rank-5 RESHAPE refused per attention layer; graph fragments into CPU islands

entries.conditions: delegate error: 'STABLEHLO_PAD: Operation is not supported.' Non-constant pad modes (reflect) survive as stablehlo composite; paired with GATHER_ND in kokoro vocoder/prosody.

rewrite_hints.expected_effect: pad chain fully delegated; verified on the 3-way reflect construct probe
rewrite_hints.rewrite: same as the GATHER_ND reflect hint: slice + flip (REVERSE_V2) + concat, or slice + reversal-matmul + concat
rewrite_hints.symptom: reflect/replicate padding kept as STABLEHLO_PAD, refused by the delegate
